rca_of_the_issue.bug: TypeError: (overrideMsg || input).trim is not a function
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: In CvlBrainFloat.jsx, the sendMessage function was called from button onClick without wrapping in arrow function. When onClick={sendMessage} is used, React passes the click event as the first argument. The function expected either a string (from quick actions) or undefined (from Enter key), but received an event object.
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: Added type check: const msgToSend = typeof overrideMsg === 'string' ? overrideMsg : null; This ensures only string values are used as override messages.
